unit.title: Engineering a Straight-Line Program Interpreter
unit.scope: One manager-authored kickoff unit; it is not a reconstruction of the unavailable official lab handout and does not represent the rest of the course.

basis.relationship: The description supplies only the topic. The specification and exercises in this unit are newly authored for this learning-factory attempt.

unit.audience: A student strong in algorithms who is building production-oriented software-engineering habits.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of C++ value and ownership semantics
learning_objectives: Model a small language with explicit, type-safe abstract syntax
Implement deterministic, left-to-right evaluation with visible state and output
Implement a side-effect-free structural analysis over the same syntax tree
Design explicit error behavior for invalid programs and integer operations
Build a reproducible CMake and CTest workflow with focused automated tests
Explain ownership, invariants, complexity, and test strategy in a short design note
required_artifacts: CMake build and CTest test suite
Written responses to the comprehension prompts

completion_policy.unit_completion: The kickoff unit may be marked complete only after a worker-harness-controlled validator confirms the required implementation, tests, documentation, and comprehension submission against the examiner rubric.
required_evidence: A clean configure, build, and CTest run from a fresh build directory
Independent behavioral checks for interpreter semantics, analysis, and errors
Manual review of the design note and comprehension responses
completion_policy.course_effect: Passing this unit records only kickoff_slp_interpreter_v1 as complete. The course must remain in progress until separately prepared units cover the intended course scope and each is independently validated.

provenance.provenance_note: Only the catalog snapshot embedded in JOB.md was used. No linked course, textbook, slide, or repository content was fetched.

validation.meaning: Artifact structure was prepared for validation; no learner work or course completion has been validated.
